config.btwrsl.tooltip.draw_margin:
Padding to add when drawing penalties to the screen.
Has no effect when draw mode is "BTW"
config.btwrsl.tooltip.draw_mode:
Determines how penalties are drawn to the screen.
"BTW" emulates Better Than Wolves rendering
config.btwrsl.tooltip.hunger_override:
Forces the penalty display to think the hunger
bar is being rendered. Does nothing
if the hunger bar is actually rendered.
config.btwrsl.tooltip.render_x: Horizontally offsets the penalty rendering by the given amount
config.btwrsl.tooltip.render_y: Vertically offsets the penalty rendering by the given amount
